notes.title: January 31st Update
notes.content:
An EXIT menu has been added.
This allows you to exit the app from the title screen without using the ESC key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45364687/1d879a5bd2d79cec92eba325c17b9af3c0ac89b3.png[/img]

notes.title: January 20th Update
notes.content:
We've changed the method to one that doesn't use vertical sync.
This cannot be confirmed in a development environment, so please let us know if you encounter any problems.
